extension.summary: Browse and play EON On Demand
extension.description: Browses the video on demand catalogue of the EON TV streaming platform (eon.tv) and plays films and series in Kodi.[CR][CR]Uses the account, device and stream credentials already held by [B]pvr.eon[/B]. The VOD plugin does not store independent EON credentials and does not create a second EON device or session.[CR][CR]Install and configure [B]pvr.eon[/B] first, then open Live TV once so it can log in and save the session.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by United Group, SBB, Telemach, Vivacom, Nova or any related company. A valid EON subscription is required. No content is provided or hosted by this add-on.
extension.platform: linux android-armv7 android-aarch64 osx-arm64 osx-x86_64 windows-x86_64
extension.language: en sr bs hr sl mk bg el
extension.news: [B]Features[/B][CR][CR]- Browses EON On Demand content from the API.[CR]- Uses the same account, session and device data as pvr.eon.[CR]- Movies, Series, Kids, Documentaries, TV shows.[CR]- Caches the catalogue locally for faster browsing.[CR]- Manual and scheduled sync, with progress shown in the corner when scheduled.[CR]- Filters unsubscribed content when configured to do so.[CR]- Age rating filter, with children's titles exempt.[CR]- Resume playback, watched marks, favourites and search history.[CR]- Plays through inputstream.adaptive, with Widevine where required.
